hypothesis: Concrete Dictionary.TryAdd can remove a second lookup when direct-base custom Razor pages register an additional section. The ordinary RazorPage override does not reach this body, so F043 measurements cannot validate F044.
proposedScope: Preserve the public virtual method, argument order, duplicate branch and attempted-name error message.
Use the existing non-virtual get-only SectionWriters property and its sole concrete readonly dictionary initializer; do not change the private field or public API.
Change only the RazorPageBase registration body and focused preservation coverage in the existing RazorPageTest class, which already tests the shared base implementation's other behaviors.
Do not change RazorPage.DefineSection, its override, layout behavior, dictionary allocation, manifests or the permanently closed F043 case.
Keep experimental source independent of F043 and David Fowler's distinct lazy-allocation work.
validation: Build and actually characterize the latest observed current-default owner before changing shipping code.
Compile six actual cshtml producers with an explicit @inherits Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Razor.RazorPageBase directive.
Require every compiled producer's direct base and resolved DefineSection declaration to be RazorPageBase, not RazorPage or a harness reimplementation.

Verify deferred registration, exact names and dictionary/delegate identity, then execute actual RazorView.RenderAsync with a real RazorPage layout, real scoped MemoryPoolViewBufferScope, transferred original dictionary and exact final HTML.
Cover ordinal-ignore-case duplicates and attempted spelling, preserved original callback, empty names, externally populated null-valued slots, null argument order and unchanged state on rejection.
Exercise the protected legacy editor overload through a small direct-base probe without substituting it for the actual compiler-generated producers.
Execute the owning RazorPageTest class on original and candidate; inspect actual TRX rows, including every new parameterized case.
Bind all selected physical sources to matching loaded owner PE/PDB documents and record the complete frozen consumer image.
Keep all non-owner image files, including the measured harness DLL/PDB, byte-identical across original and candidate.

measuredBoundaries.includes: A fresh actual compiled direct-base page and its normal per-page collections/delegates, real generated ExecuteAsync/base DefineSection, and count readback.
measuredBoundaries.excludes: Compilation, service/context setup, section callback execution, layout rendering, HTTP and the ordinary RazorPage override.
measuredBoundaries.contextReuse: Reuse only the setup-created registration ViewContext; every page and section dictionary must be new per operation.

measuredBoundaries.includes: A fresh actual compiled direct-base content page, actual RazorView dictionary transfer, real RazorPage layout section consumption, scoped pooled buffering, exact HTML validation and disposal.
measuredBoundaries.excludes: Compilation, production view discovery/unused helper injection, hosted requests, browser and network.
measuredBoundaries.purpose: Faithful output and rendering-boundary preservation; not an unchanged-code control or an application-throughput claim.

primary.reason: Two registrations are the smallest full-page custom-base workload reaching an already populated store. This is an explicitly custom-base path, not a claim about ordinary generated MVC pages or production frequency.

decisionRules: Stop after one complete comparison only for a clear approximately 50 percent primary improvement with preservation and control checks passing.
Otherwise allow at most three source-comparison authorizations, including failed or partial timed attempts; retain adverse results.
Use the median of paired percentage effects, never replace the declared primary with a scaled winner.

NoSections is the predeclared unchanged-path control at both boundaries. Review variability and allocation movement; do not credit a small primary result that is no larger than the corresponding unchanged registration control in at least two of three comparisons.
Publish One, all scaled and long-name profiles, both boundaries, every allocation outcome and uncertainty.
Classify no-gain rather than open a performance PR if the primary numerical or credibility criteria fail.
A qualified custom-base registration result is not a normal RazorPage, full-view or application-speedup result.
Do not alter shared-machine priority, affinity, power settings, protected dependency manifests or unrelated processes.
